color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Bun runtime
reads env vars on startup

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0
disables SSL cert validation
(Node-compat name)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BUN_CONFIG_VERBOSE_FETCH=curl
logs URL, method, req/resp headers
=1 → same without curl output
(also node:http)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BUN_CONFIG_MAX_HTTPS
max concurrent fetch + bun install
default: 256
lower for rate limits / conn issues

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BUN_RUNTIME_TRANSPILER_CACHE_PATH
caches transpiled output >4KB
→ faster CLI loads

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TMPDIR
intermediate assets during bundling
unset → /tmp (Linux) · /private/tmp (macOS)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FORCE_COLOR=1
forces ANSI on
overrides NO_COLOR

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BUN_CONFIG_NO_CLEAR_TERMINAL_ON_RELOAD=true
bun --watch doesn't clear console on reload

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DO_NOT_TRACK=1
disables crash report upload to bun.report
+ all telemetry
(macOS/Windows: crash uploads default-on)

div.style: color: rgb(248, 248, 242) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BUN_OPTIONS
prepends CLI args to any Bun execution
e.g. BUN_OPTIONS='--hot'
→ bun run dev == bun --hot run dev
